clusters.name: commandonpath-fix
clusters.executionModeRationale: Single small submodule change set with a release tail. All three stories target the same ai-developer-toolkit submodule and US-003 mutates the shared version stamps, so they must run serially in one job to avoid version-file write conflicts and keep the diff reviewable as one coherent 'no bash in the command-on-PATH preflight' ship. Parallelization buys nothing here.
